snippet.title: Dark Souls: All Saints' Day Trailer
snippet.description:
With tense dungeon crawling and fearsome enemy encounters, the seamlessly intertwined world of Dark Souls is full of extreme battles, rewarding challenges, nuanced weaponry and magic, and the flexibility to customize each character to suit any desired play style.

Dark Souls will be available on Xbox 360 and Playstation 3 on October 4th 2011.

For more information, check out the official website http://www.preparetodie.com and on http://www.facebook.com/darksouls
http://www.twitter.com/filthierich

ESRB Rating: MATURE with Blood and Gore, Partial Nudity, Violence
